name: Battle.net Login
description: Allow users to sign in with their Battle.net account
author: uxwVend

battlenetAuth.adm_subtitle: Set up Battle.net OAuth sign-in for your site.
battlenetAuth.adm_issuerNote: AUTH_BATTLENET_ISSUER picks the region and has to be one of https://oauth.battle.net, https://eu.battle.net/oauth, https://us.battle.net/oauth, https://kr.battle.net/oauth, https://tw.battle.net/oauth, https://oauth.battlenet.com.cn or https://www.battlenet.com.cn/oauth. Sign-in stays off until it holds one of them.
battlenetAuth.adm_emailNote: Battle.net does not share an email address, so an account created this way gets a placeholder one that can never receive mail. Ask these users to set a real address in their profile.

battlenetAuth.adm_subtitle: Siteniz için Battle.net ile OAuth girişini yapılandırın.
battlenetAuth.adm_issuerNote: AUTH_BATTLENET_ISSUER bölgeyi seçer ve şu adreslerden biri olmalıdır: https://oauth.battle.net, https://eu.battle.net/oauth, https://us.battle.net/oauth, https://kr.battle.net/oauth, https://tw.battle.net/oauth, https://oauth.battlenet.com.cn veya https://www.battlenet.com.cn/oauth. Bu değer bunlardan biri olmadıkça giriş açılmaz.
battlenetAuth.adm_emailNote: Battle.net e-posta adresi paylaşmaz, bu yüzden bu yolla açılan hesaba posta alamayan geçici bir adres atanır. Bu kullanıcılardan profillerinde gerçek bir adres tanımlamalarını isteyin.

battlenetAuth.adm_subtitle: OAuth-Anmeldung über Battle.net für Ihre Seite einrichten.
battlenetAuth.adm_issuerNote: AUTH_BATTLENET_ISSUER wählt die Region und muss einer dieser Werte sein: https://oauth.battle.net, https://eu.battle.net/oauth, https://us.battle.net/oauth, https://kr.battle.net/oauth, https://tw.battle.net/oauth, https://oauth.battlenet.com.cn oder https://www.battlenet.com.cn/oauth. Ohne einen davon bleibt die Anmeldung aus.
battlenetAuth.adm_emailNote: Battle.net gibt keine E-Mail-Adresse heraus. Ein so erstelltes Konto erhält daher eine Platzhalteradresse, die keine Post empfangen kann. Bitten Sie diese Nutzer, im Profil eine echte Adresse zu hinterlegen.

battlenetAuth.adm_subtitle: Configura el inicio de sesión OAuth con Battle.net para tu sitio.
battlenetAuth.adm_issuerNote: AUTH_BATTLENET_ISSUER elige la región y tiene que ser uno de https://oauth.battle.net, https://eu.battle.net/oauth, https://us.battle.net/oauth, https://kr.battle.net/oauth, https://tw.battle.net/oauth, https://oauth.battlenet.com.cn o https://www.battlenet.com.cn/oauth. El inicio de sesión no se activa hasta que contenga uno de ellos.
battlenetAuth.adm_emailNote: Battle.net no comparte ninguna dirección de correo, así que una cuenta creada por esta vía recibe una dirección provisional que no puede recibir mensajes. Pide a estos usuarios que definan una real en su perfil.

battlenetAuth.adm_subtitle: Configurez la connexion OAuth Battle.net pour votre site.
battlenetAuth.adm_issuerNote: AUTH_BATTLENET_ISSUER choisit la région et doit valoir https://oauth.battle.net, https://eu.battle.net/oauth, https://us.battle.net/oauth, https://kr.battle.net/oauth, https://tw.battle.net/oauth, https://oauth.battlenet.com.cn ou https://www.battlenet.com.cn/oauth. Tant que ce n'est pas le cas, la connexion reste inactive.
battlenetAuth.adm_emailNote: Battle.net ne communique aucune adresse e-mail : un compte créé ainsi reçoit une adresse fictive qui ne peut rien recevoir. Demandez à ces utilisateurs d'en définir une vraie dans leur profil.

battlenetAuth.adm_subtitle: Настройте вход на сайт через Battle.net по OAuth.
battlenetAuth.adm_issuerNote: AUTH_BATTLENET_ISSUER задаёт регион и должен быть одним из: https://oauth.battle.net, https://eu.battle.net/oauth, https://us.battle.net/oauth, https://kr.battle.net/oauth, https://tw.battle.net/oauth, https://oauth.battlenet.com.cn или https://www.battlenet.com.cn/oauth. Пока значение другое, вход не включается.
battlenetAuth.adm_emailNote: Battle.net не передаёт адрес почты, поэтому созданный так аккаунт получает временный адрес, на который ничего нельзя отправить. Попросите таких пользователей указать настоящий адрес в профиле.

battlenetAuth.adm_subtitle: Configure o início de sessão OAuth com Battle.net no seu site.
battlenetAuth.adm_issuerNote: AUTH_BATTLENET_ISSUER escolhe a região e tem de ser um de https://oauth.battle.net, https://eu.battle.net/oauth, https://us.battle.net/oauth, https://kr.battle.net/oauth, https://tw.battle.net/oauth, https://oauth.battlenet.com.cn ou https://www.battlenet.com.cn/oauth. Enquanto não for, o início de sessão fica desligado.
battlenetAuth.adm_emailNote: O Battle.net não partilha um endereço de email, por isso uma conta criada assim recebe um endereço provisório que não consegue receber mensagens. Peça a estes utilizadores que definam um real no perfil.
